title: M5 consistency verification plus quality gate
instructions: Use the accepted M4 staging-write artifact and existing clean manifest with status quality-pending. Use one real DuckDB engine connection opened OPEN_READONLY against source C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading/data/quant.duckdb, and in the same verification run query both source daily_basic and the real target Parquet via read_parquet. Verification scope is fixed to daily_basic/month=2026-05. Compare canonical structural columns only: ts_code, trade_date, turnover_rate, volume_ratio, pe, pb, ps, total_mv, circ_mv, source, ingest_run_id. Do not SELECT * because target read_parquet may expose a derived hive partition column month. Cover row count, date range, logical key set, duplicate key count, key non-null, numeric columns, null distribution, provenance distribution, order-independent checksum, and source-target EXCEPT counts. If all checks pass, atomically update the existing clean manifest status from quality-pending to quality-passed and add/update only checksum/quality fields. If any check fails, leave or set status to quality-failed/quality-pending and record failure details. Do not write _current.json. Do not create or modify metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json. Do not write target Parquet or source DuckDB. Write consistency and quality artifacts, then finish the task for Claude review.
summary: M5 consistency verification and quality gate completed for daily_basic month=2026-05. Used one real node-duckdb OPEN_READONLY connection to query both source daily_basic and target read_parquet canonical columns. Verified source and target row_count=75018, duplicate_key_count=0, key non-null, logical key set hash match, ordered row checksum match, null/numeric/provenance distributions match, source-minus-target=0 and target-minus-source=0. Atomically updated existing clean manifest from quality-pending to quality-passed, adding checksum/quality fields only. No source write/DDL, no target Parquet write, no _current.json write, no query-entry pointer write, and no M6+ task files created.
